coordinate_convention: Native Y-up row-vector rig matrices. Native appearance_scale applies outside the rig, independently of cockpit scale.

provenance.status: Native metadata and animation reconstruction; all-race runtime samples not available. Armoured reconstruction provides a separate shared-path check.
provenance.topology: Native endpoint insertion and ancestor recursion; head record follows GcAlienRace enum. Scene exclusion byte and race field writer not independently sampled for this preset.
provenance.constraint_state: Shared default seated constraint settings; confirmed against captured Armoured, source-defined for this appearance.
provenance.cached_extent_method: Union of all native joint AABBs across selected geometry, transformed by default 0H_IDLE_WEIGHT_SHIFT_HEADS frame 0 including appearance morphs. No ship geometry is involved.
provenance.bone_scale_semantics: Native solver FK compensates parent local scale; GEK uses its own nonuniform limb scales and own cockpit animation.
